native.boundary: Windows SendInput / existing WeType path was exercised, not CDP text insertion for IME. compositionstart/update and native input were trusted; the observed compositionend events had isTrusted=false and are preserved as received. This does not prove WeType naturally reproduces the synthetic old-package event-order defect. No human typing interference observed; no formal performance sample.

Initial QA5 candidate loses preceding unpublished input on rejected multiline paste; final identical script rejects this candidate.
Earlier trusted Ctrl+V version independently reproduced the same initial-candidate permission-reset defect; final regression avoids the shared system clipboard.
Invalid clean Ctrl+S test setup: clean shortcut intentionally does not dispatch save. Test removed; not a product defect.
Initial candidate: first 38 suites passed, perf3g return-reader was blocked by an input/save guard. Exact cause unconfirmed.
Same initial ASAR, unchanged perf3g rerun passed; preceding 38 log hashes verified and reused. Does not erase the first failure.

Intermediate B runtime: first 17 suites passed, a7-3b timed out at reader menu arrow navigation. Diagnostic rerun passed; exact initial cause not established. Test now waits for the existing scheduled focus initialization before retaining the same navigation assertion.

Intermediate B runtime resumed with 17 verified passing suites, then UX3 exposed a product regression: rejected cross-leaf native text was not restored after feedback disposed the session. Final C distinguishes draft ownership from handed-off text; all 39 final C suites rerun without reused results.
B physical IME acceptance passed on its identified ASAR; kept as intermediate evidence, not used for final C physical acceptance.
Read-only focus journal and two-frame observation on the same final ASAR; full a7-3b flow passed. This does not prove the first timeout root cause.
Invalid first diagnostic script inserted a reader journal reference into the earlier source-menu arrow site; corrected the diagnostic site, without changing product code.

First final-C Vite run: QA5/QA4 passed, QA3 drag had 8/9 cases pass and one DevTools target connection assertion before pointer validation. Server stopped; all ten suites rerun on the same ASAR and unchanged scripts.
